data.answer: In the 2015 mining study, **publicly funded entities** most often co-filed with other organisations (21 per cent), while **mining equipment, technology and services (METS) firms** did so least often (3.6 per cent).[1] These results cover PCT applications only, so they are not comprehensive.[2]

citations.quote: METS firms collaborate the least (3.6 per cent) and publicly funded collaborate the most (21 per cent).
collaboration was determined by looking at PCT applications with more than one applicant

claims.text: The 2015 mining study found that publicly funded entities co-filed most often (21 per cent) and METS firms least often (3.6 per cent).

citations.quote: These results are based on the subset comprising PCT applications only so is not comprehensive
